title: FAQ: Everyone Pay
summary: This FAQ for “Everyone Pay” lists sending limits (daily $1,500, monthly $12,500), the $0.75 fee for instant transfers, a 17-minute window to cancel eligible payments, and a cap of up to $550 saved contacts. It also advises on standard delivery, recipient verification, and what to check if a payment fails or is declined.
